title.narrative: TJK_Challenging Harmful Attitudes and Norms for Gender Equality (CHANGE)

description.narrative: Tajikistan has taken important steps to address gender inequality and domestic violence, including the adoption of the National Programme and Action Plan on the Elimination of Domestic Violence (2025–2030) and the establishment of a Multisectoral Council in 2025 to strengthen coordination and implementation. These efforts aim to address discriminatory gender norms and improve prevention and response mechanisms. Despite progress, significant gaps remain in legal frameworks and enforcement. Existing legislation does not fully criminalize all forms of domestic violence, and proposed amendments are still pending. Challenges persist in the effective implementation of laws, provision of survivor-centered services, and prevention of workplace harassment. Limited awareness of rights further restricts access to justice, particularly among women.
